home.subtitle: EcoTrack turns everyday choices — your commute, your meals, your electricity bill — into a number you can see, compare and bring down. Seven categories. Published science. No guesswork.

login.subtitle: Sign in to pick your footprint up where you left it — every activity you have logged, the trend behind it, and the goals still running.
login.feature1Note: the server checks your identity on every request
login.feature2Note: there is nothing to pay and no trial to expire
login.resetSubtitle: Enter the email on your account and we'll send a link to choose a new password.

register.subtitle: Three short steps, then one logged activity — a car trip, an electricity bill, a meal — is enough to bring the whole dashboard to life.
register.accountExists: An account already exists for this email.
register.regionHint: Emission factors vary by region — this keeps your results accurate.
register.googleNoPassword: No password to choose — Google has already verified your email

dashboard.subtitleNoData: Log your first activity to bring this dashboard to life.
dashboard.emptyStateBody: Your first entry takes about thirty seconds. Log one car journey or one electricity bill and every chart below fills in.

dashboard.noEmissionsThisMonth: No emissions recorded this month yet.

dashboard.oneLeverTitle: Cutting your own footprint is one lever
dashboard.oneLeverBody: The other is funding the people already doing it. Anything you give through EcoTrack goes straight on to climate organisations — we keep nothing.
dashboard.wakingServer: Waking up the server — the first request after a quiet spell can take a few seconds.

calculator.anomalyBody: {{reason}} If that's right, log it as-is.

calculator.budgetNote: Your climate-safe budget this year works out at {{value}} kg a month.

institution.eyebrow: For a green cell or eco-club lead
institution.subtitleNoInstitution: Run several classroom groups as one institution, with an inter-class league table.
institution.subtitleHasInstitution: An aggregate, per-classroom view — never a single student's row.
institution.createExplainer: For a campus green cell, eco-club, or department running several classroom groups at once. You'll get an invite code to hand to each classroom's own organizer — they link their class in from their own Household page, on their own terms. You only ever see combined totals per class, never an individual student's name or record.
institution.inviteCodeHint: Hand this to a classroom's own organizer — they link it in from their Household page.
institution.emptyClassrooms: No classrooms linked yet. Share your invite code with a classroom's organizer to get started.
